dimensions.assessment: Affects all law enforcement officers and firefighters employed by the federal government, states, local governments, or Indian Tribes who utilize federal recreational lands.
dimensions.evidence: a law enforcement officer or firefighter... who provide adequate proof of eligibility

dimensions.assessment: Provides a financial benefit by waiving recreational pass fees for eligible individuals.
dimensions.evidence: make the National Parks and Federal Recreational Lands Pass available, at no cost, to... a law enforcement officer or firefighter

dimensions.assessment: Reduces federal recreational fee revenue by providing passes without charge, though exact financial totals are not stated.
Amends the Federal Lands Recreation Enhancement Act to add pass eligibility categories and definitions.
dimensions.evidence: Section 805(b) of the Federal Lands Recreation Enhancement Act (16 U.S.C. 6804(b)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change providing ongoing pass benefits to eligible personnel.

missing_information: Estimated number of eligible law enforcement officers and firefighters nationwide.
Projected reduction in federal recreational fee collections.
importance_detail.rationale: Expands eligibility for the National Parks and Federal Recreational Lands Pass to include law enforcement officers and firefighters at no cost.
